_comment: Spectre Voice Server egg for Pterodactyl (PTDL_v2). Guide: deploy/pterodactyl/README.md
name: Spectre Voice
author: support@spectrevoice.com
description: Spectre Voice Server: voice, chat, games and streams for a community. One port (TCP for the apps, UDP for the voice, the same number). The plan's places are set by the host (SV_MAX_USERS, 10 to 1000) and unlocked by the host's plan code (SV_PARTNER_CODE).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Spectre Voice Server — Pterodactyl install (runs in the installer container; the server's files are /mnt/server)
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update -qq >/dev/null && apt-get install -y -qq curl ca-certificates xz-utils >/dev/null
cd /mnt/server
ARCH=$([[ "$(uname -m)" == "aarch64" ]] && echo arm64 || echo amd64)
BASE="${DOWNLOAD_BASE:-https://github.com/Stefan3Dx/SpectreVoice-Server/releases/latest/download}"
echo "Spectre Voice Server: downloading for ${ARCH} from ${BASE}"
curl -fsSL "${BASE}/spectrevoice-server-linux-${ARCH}.tar.gz" -o s.tgz
curl -fsSL "${BASE}/SHA256SUMS" -o SHA256SUMS
grep "linux-${ARCH}.tar.gz" SHA256SUMS | sed "s|spectrevoice-server-linux-${ARCH}.tar.gz|s.tgz|" | sha256sum -c --quiet
tar -xzf s.tgz && rm -f s.tgz SHA256SUMS
chmod 755 spectrevoice-server
mkdir -p data bin
# The music bot (optional): yt-dlp and a static ffmpeg, in ./bin
if [[ "${INSTALL_MUSIC:-0}" == "1" ]]; then
  echo "Music bot: yt-dlp and ffmpeg"
  yt=$([[ $ARCH == arm64 ]] && echo yt-dlp_linux_aarch64 || echo yt-dlp_linux)
  curl -fsSL "https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/releases/latest/download/${yt}" -o bin/yt-dlp && chmod 755 bin/yt-dlp
  ff=$([[ $ARCH == arm64 ]] && echo linuxarm64 || echo linux64)
  curl -fsSL "https://github.com/BtbN/FFmpeg-Builds/releases/download/latest/ffmpeg-master-latest-${ff}-gpl.tar.xz" -o ff.txz
  tar -xJf ff.txz --strip-components=2 -C bin --wildcards '*/bin/ffmpeg' && rm -f ff.txz
fi
echo "Spectre Voice Server installed. The owner's claim code is printed at the first start (and kept in data/claim.code)."

variables.name: Server name
variables.description: The name people see in the apps.

variables.name: Contact e-mail
variables.description: For people's data requests (GDPR), shown at /privacy.

variables.name: Places (plan)
variables.description: People connected at once: the plan's size, 10 to 1000. Set by the host.

variables.name: Plan code
variables.description: The host's plan code (SVP-…) from the Spectre Voice partner API: it unlocks the places above 30. Hidden from the customer.

variables.name: Public address
variables.description: The node's public IP or name, announced for the voice (needed behind NAT).

variables.name: Invite links base
variables.description: e.g. https://voice.example.com/i/ when a domain points at this server; empty: the server's address.

variables.name: TURN relay
variables.description: Optional: turn:relay.example.com:3478 for people behind strict networks.

variables.name: Music bot
variables.description: 1: install yt-dlp and ffmpeg (reinstall to apply) and turn the music bot on.

variables.name: Music bot on
variables.description: true or false (needs the music bot installed).

variables.name: Download from
variables.description: Where the server is downloaded from (releases).
